visualReview.notes: Inspected54 final current frames:12 portable,12 shared-material/flat-map and30 Earth-rig/native-field/four-tier views. Complete original442m Kingkey100 tower includes its bowed curtain-wall enclosure,pale vertical fins/floor rails,four dark mechanical belts,curved crown andsmall reconstructed roof plant,deep arched south glazed hood with actual diagonal lattice/transverse ribs,a recessed curved lobby with three physical revolving-door assemblies,andcircular reflecting pool/nozzles. Source preserves pane recess returns andfine grids;four browser tiers simplify details while retaining the whole silhouette. The exact retained Q1470046 plan plus independent native441.8m shaft and24–44m south hood fix scale andorientation. Anchor[114.101581167,22.545691754],heading.001116525734,+X east,+Z south entry/watercourt,-Z north independent KK Mall. Native mall andadjacent bank/residential towers are separate context,not a442m podium extrusion. Retained442m total includes the small roof plant;bowed profile,mechanical belt levels,104 reconstructed rows,fin/pane/lattice/door/pool counts andsections are original photo proportions,not anas-built schedule. First render inspection caught a floating-point endpoint resetting one crown ring to ground dimensions;the final profile/row boundary correction removes this spurious thin roof shelf andhas a regression assertion. Four focused tests prove byte-exact master reconstruction,signed source-map frame andplacement,native terrain hash/sampling,whole curved crown/arch/watercourt geometry,physical near doorway recess/ceiling,andfour exact budgeted LODs with shared materials and separate GPU streams. Production viewer removes the three actual native tower/entrance parts while preserving four real neighbors,including independently mapped northern KK Mall. Six GLBs have zero validator errors/warnings andzero embedded images. Four existing256px window-grid,painted-metal,membrane andgranite graphs are shared with other models. Restrained vertex colors supply pale fins,dark belts andportable blue-gray glazing;shared window binding uses the catalog blue grid. Pool uses a low-cost opaque tinted shared surface. Glass/canopy/pool are opaque approximations without optical interior/transparency/water simulation;portable fallback andshared viewer appearance differ. No private texture copies,baked highlights or downloaded geometry. Unmodified129x129/2m field oversamples one standard global urban terrain tile.18m rounded center datum androughly14–20m native corners remain approximate. Foundation skirt embeds in retained terrain;raised eastern native returns visibly intersect the eastern sector of the reflecting pool andright lobby edge. Lower pool visibility andoriginal site grades are not certified;this global-DEM obstruction remains explicit. Original curb,pool,accessible-entry andas-built foundation grades are not surveyed or certified;terrain is not flattened. Interior,branding,tree/planter/landscape context andindependent surrounding buildings are excluded. Generic synthetic close cameras crop the tall tower;custom whole/crown/hood/lobby andexplicit tier cameras establish coverage. Minor facet/shadow/LOD differences,certified mesh-distance errors andphysical-device/dense-city timing remain unmeasured.
